prompt:
This repo is a Node.js ESM project; read AGENTS.md first and follow it.

Bug: `parseResultReply` in src/reply.mjs rejects replies that were copied with ChatGPT's Copy button, because that button re-serialises the reply as Markdown. In the copied text, the marker lines are backslash-escaped, for example `<<\<ATB_RESULT:ATB_atb_demo_0123456789abcdef>>>\` and `<<\<ATB_FILE:...>>> src/a.mjs` and `<<\<ATB_END:...>>>`. Escaping can hit `<`, `>` and `_` inside a marker, and hard-break lines end in a trailing backslash. The `status:` and `summary:` lines can also end in a trailing backslash.

Make `parseResultReply` accept this escaped form and return the same result as for the unescaped reply. Only marker lines (lines that start with the `<<<ATB_` marker, in escaped or plain form) and the `status:` / `summary:` values may be unescaped. File content inside code fences must never be altered, so a literal backslash in a file stays a backslash.

Add a regression test to test/round-trip.test.mjs. The plugin runtimes under plugins/ are generated from src/, so run `npm run bundle:plugins` after editing src/. Finish with a passing `npm test`.

delegation.title: Accept Markdown-escaped replies
delegation.workUnit: Fix parseResultReply in src/reply.mjs for Markdown-escaped marker lines and add a regression test to test/round-trip.test.mjs.
acceptance_criteria: An escaped reply (marker lines with backslash-escaped brackets and a trailing backslash, and a trailing backslash on status/summary values) parses to the same result as the plain reply
Only marker lines and status/summary values are unescaped
File content inside code fences is never altered; a literal backslash in a file stays a backslash
A regression test covers the escaped form and npm test passes
non_goals: Changing the reply format or markers
hostSteps: Regenerating the plugin runtimes under plugins/ with npm run bundle:plugins
